text:
lina: Quick FYI — spotted a mismatch between the Console dashboard 'Cost by model' widget and the SDK cost/latency example in the docs during today's smoke run.

morgan: ugh, that's not good. Which SDK example specifically?

lina: The JS snippet under /docs/console/costs.md showing `estimateRequestCost()` — numbers are ~20% lower than the dashboard for identical request traces.

sam: Could be unit mismatch (tokens vs effective tokens) or we lost a multiplier. Can you paste the snippet?

lina: Here — from branch docs/cost-snippet-fix:
```
const cost = estimateRequestCost({ model: 'redwood-medium', tokens: 420, latencyMs: 230 })
console.log(cost)
```

lina: The dashboard uses aggregated token meters + batching overhead. I think our example omits prefix caching impact.

raj: Hmm, dashboard pipeline applies a `batching_overhead = max(1, ceil(tokens/512)) * 0.05` factor (see service metrics). Snippet doesn't.

morgan: if that's the case simple fix: update docs example to call `estimateRequestCost({..., includeBatchingOverhead:true})` and show both numbers.

lina: I'll open a PR with a revised snippet + a short note explaining batching and prefix cache effects. but I wanted to check if anyone objects to changing the example numbers in the quickstart (we ship that in the SDK snippet tests)

sam: No objection. Also add a link to the console widget explanation page so people can reconcile numbers. tiny extra UX win.

raj: Also add a one-line note under the dashboard docs that 'Dashboard numbers include batching and KV-prefix cache amortization' — helps support tickets.

morgan: CI bot will fail if the snippet tests are not updated. @ci-bot can you re-run the snippet test for PR when it's up?

ci-bot: scheduled: running snippets/test for PR #462 (docs/cost-snippet-fix) — results pending :hourglass:

lina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/462 — includes updated JS + Python snippets, a short migration note, and link to console explanation. feedback welcome.

morgan: quick scan looks good. two requests: 1) add an example of how to toggle the batching flag in SDK (one-liner), 2) confirm the numbers match staging dashboard for sample trace id `stg-9876`.

lina: will do. I'll run the sample trace through staging and paste exact outputs.

sam: For release checklist: Docs fix should not block today's console deploy — it's low risk. But coordinate timing: if deploy flips widget behavior we should release docs after deploy or mark as 'may differ until rollout completes'.

raj: Good point. The backend rollout that introduced the overhead metric is scheduled at 15:30 UTC. If deploy completes, numbers will align. Add a short note in PR: "may differ until 15:30 UTC rollout completes".

lina: Added note and update to PR description.

ci-bot: snippets/test for PR #462 passed :white_check_mark: (JS + Python). Link check failed on one internal console docs anchor.

morgan: which link?

ci-bot: /docs/console/costs.md -> anchor `#batching-and-overhead` not found.

lina: I'll add the anchor to the console widget page and push a tiny doc tweak.

lina: pushed fix — updated console widget page with anchor `#batching-and-overhead` and added small paragraph.

ci-bot: re-run link-check: success :white_check_mark:

sam: staging check: I ran `estimateRequestCost` with sample trace stg-9876 — snippet shows $0.047, staging dashboard shows $0.049 (within expected jitter). good to ship.

morgan: great. merging PR after CI completes. @deploy-bot please hold off running doc-site deployment until I finish a final glance (5–10m).

deploy-bot: acknowledged. holding docs deploy.

lina: thanks y'all. I'll follow up in #support if we see any customer questions tomorrow.

morgan: merge done. docs deploy unblocked in 3m.

deploy-bot: deploying docs site... :rocket:

deploy-bot: docs deploy success — https://docs.redwood.ai (published) :tada:

lina: verified the published page, numbers and new anchor look good. closing thread.
